items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution, authorize no spend or monetization expansion, and continue only the existing report-only finance reconciliation. Amazon evidence is limited to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21; the commission is not site-attributable, so revenue claims, contribution margin, ROI, payback, and forecasts are unsupported. AI usage cost is $934.99756275 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29 across 5,174 calls, including 229 errors; it must not be compared with one day of revenue or treated as a monthly run rate. Budget exposure is not calculable because monthly spend, fixed-cost, marketing-budget, and revenue-floor fields are blank; minimum measurement is an approved budget and commitment ledger by period. Infrastructure spend is not calculable because no infrastructure-cost ledger is supplied and operations sweeps have no results; minimum measurement is a matching-period hosting, domain, tooling, and deployment-cost ledger. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because no approved threshold, complete matching-period cost base, or attributable outcome exists; minimum measurement is an approved threshold plus experiment-level cost and attributable outcome identifiers. Preserve all unavailable fields as unknown and do not extrapolate.

Continue period-aligned reconciliation only. Preserve the 2026-09-21 Amazon result as aggregate and unattributed: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. Keep matching-period costs, budgets, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, infrastructure spend, and cost-to-learn unknown; do not extrapolate or authorize spend.
